title: Graph representations of dislocation networks
summary: Graph representations of simulated dislocation networks show that the joint graph description and strain-rate prediction remains robust across the tested geometry encodings; the study does not establish an independently superior descriptor.
ai_technology: Specific simulation-based finding that the joint graph-description and strain-rate prediction is robust to the tested geometry encodings
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Simulation-based graph encodings and strain-rate prediction evaluated across the geometries reported in the study.
evidence.unknown: External generalization, independent replication and downstream real-world impact were not established by the reviewed source.
evidence.ai_role: Graph representations and learned prediction model encode dislocation-network geometry and predict strain-rate behavior.
